zh.lead: 今天最大的产品消息：OpenClaw 今早发布实验版 v2026.11.5-beta.3，侧重大会话可靠性与重启投递安全；Grok Bot 的 Homebrew cask 已报 1.1.0，但官方 changelog Latest 仍为 11/11 的 v1.0.1。今天是周日，文末另有本周趋势总结。

important.title: 重要消息
items: OpenClaw 于 2026-11-15T00:31:00Z（约北京时间 08:31）发布预发布标签 v2026.11.5-beta.3。要点包括：降低大会话在转写索引、裁剪与压缩时的内存压力；重启时保留排队消息的权限上限与已接受的入口，并在最终投递完成前保持所有权；改进冷启动、中断工作区恢复与安装权限。此外恢复按上下文大小的默认输出预算，以及可配置的摘要字数上限。相对 beta.2 共计入 50 个 PR。

Grok Bot 官方 changelog Latest 仍为 11/11 的 v1.0.1（含加入 Google Meet / Zoom / Microsoft Teams 与共享登录连接器）。Homebrew cask grok-bot 今日已报 1.1.0，下载地址指向 darwin-arm64 的 1.1.0 安装包，高于昨日所见的 1.0.3，也高于 changelog。按客户端与 changelog 对照规则，不以「近几日无新版本」表述；1.1.0 的功能说明官方尚未列出，故不编造。
CursorBench 4.0 较昨日无更新：官方得分仍由 Gemini 4 Carbon High（60.4% / $9.22）领跑，性价比头部仍是 GPT-5.6 Luna Low 与 Haiku 5.5 Low。关注列表里 @karpathy、@AndrewYNg、@OpenAI、@claudeai、@AIatMeta 与 @Meta 近 24–48 小时无高信号原创。

sections.title: OpenClaw 这份 beta 改了什么
sections.body: 这是一次以可靠性为主的预发布，而不是新模型或新渠道。大会话侧改为只流式加载选中的 hydration 负载，并尊重可配置的摘要上限；压缩时仍受前台请求预算约束，且会在引用的摘要里打码凭证。重启与投递侧保留已接受的入口和原来的权限，排空最后的聊天写入后再交接。修复面较宽，涵盖启动与更新、会话存储、执行进度、Slack/iMessage 等渠道、提供方设置与 Windows/macOS 恢复。官方发布说明按 beta.2 之后的提交窗口统计为 50 个 PR。

sections.title: 产品栏
sections.body: Hermes 稳定版仍为 v0.23.1；昨日下午新出现 canary（20261114），发布说明只有安装包与 smoke 结果，没有整理过的功能列表，故不编造。DeepSeek Harness 仍为 dsh-v0.2.2-rc.3。codex 稳定版仍为 0.169.0，实验线最新为 0.171.0-alpha.5，发布说明仅标版本号。Claude 自 11/12 的 Meetings 与自托管 Managed Agents 之后，新闻页未见新产品稿。Cursor changelog 自 11/6 的 Voice Chat 起仍无新条目；11/13 官方博文对 10 月底安全事件做了调查更新，已写入工程博客栏。

sections.title: 本周趋势
sections.body: 相对上周的「安全专用智能体 + Agent 记忆产品化」，本周更像一轮集中交付：Claude Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2、Gemini 4 Carbon 全面开放与 Hydrogen 日常编码主力相继落地，ChatGPT Wallet 把代理支付做进产品，Claude Meetings 让模型走进会议，OpenAI 则把 Daybreak 红队与防御工厂搬到台前。完整四点见下方「本周趋势总结」。

sections.title: 缺口
sections.body: @karpathy、@AndrewYNg、@OpenAI、@claudeai、@AIatMeta 与 @Meta 近 24–48 小时无高信号原创，今日 X 栏不强行复用昨日条目。关注列表仍无 DeepSeek 一手 X。OpenAI 新闻页今日抓取为挑战页，产品侧以已核对的 Wallet（11/13）与 GitHub 发布为准。Grok Bot 1.1.0 仅见于 Homebrew cask，官方 changelog 未列出变更。

en.lead: Biggest product news today: OpenClaw shipped experimental v2026.11.5-beta.3 this morning, focused on large-session reliability and restart/delivery safety; the Homebrew cask for Grok Bot now reports 1.1.0, while the official changelog Latest is still v1.0.1 from Nov 11. It is Sunday, so a weekly trend summary is included below.

important.title: Headlines
items: OpenClaw published the prerelease tag v2026.11.5-beta.3 at 2026-11-15T00:31:00Z (about 08:31 Asia/Shanghai). Highlights include lower memory pressure during transcript indexing, trimming, and compaction; preserving queued-message permission ceilings and accepted ingress across restarts, and keeping delivery ownership through the final RPC; plus better cold-start initialization, interrupted-workspace recovery, and installer permissions. It also restores context-sized default output budgets, adds a configurable summary-character limit, and waits for Lightpanda’s supported navigation path and sandbox files to be ready. The notes count 50 PRs since beta.2.

The official Grok Bot changelog Latest is still v1.0.1 from Nov 11 (joining Google Meet, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams, and shared-login connectors). The Homebrew cask grok-bot now reports 1.1.0, with the download pointing at the darwin-arm64 1.1.0 package — ahead of yesterday’s 1.0.3 and ahead of the changelog. Under the client-vs-changelog rule, this is not written as “no recent new version.” The official changelog does not yet list what 1.1.0 changes, so those features are not invented here.

CursorBench 4.0 is unchanged versus yesterday: the official scoreboard is still led by Gemini 4 Carbon High (60.4% / $9.22), and the value leaders remain GPT-5.6 Luna Low and Haiku 5.5 Low. On the watchlist, @karpathy, @AndrewYNg, @OpenAI, @claudeai, @AIatMeta, and @Meta had no high-signal originals in the past 24–48 hours.

sections.title: What this OpenClaw beta actually changes
sections.body: This is a reliability-focused prerelease, not a new model or channel. For large sessions it streams only selected hydration payloads and honors a configurable summary cap; compaction still respects the foreground request budget and redacts credentials in quoted summaries. On restart and delivery it keeps accepted ingress and original permissions, and drains the last chat writes before handoff. The fix list is broad: startup and updates, session storage, execution progress, Slack/iMessage and other channels, provider setup, and Windows/macOS recovery. The official notes tally 50 PRs in the window after beta.2.

sections.title: Product desk
sections.body: Hermes stable is still v0.23.1; a new canary, v0.23.1+canary.20261114T064334Z, appeared yesterday afternoon (published_at 2026-11-14T07:46:34Z). Its notes only list packages and smoke results, with no curated feature list, so none is invented here. DeepSeek Harness remains dsh-v0.2.2-rc.3. Codex stable is still 0.169.0; the experimental line is now rust-v0.171.0-alpha.5 (2026-11-14T01:20:37Z), with notes that only name the version. Claude has had no new product post on the newsroom since Meetings and self-hosted Managed Agents on Nov 12. Cursor’s changelog still has no entry after Voice Chat on Nov 6; a Nov 13 company post updates the late-October security incident and is covered in the engineering-blog section.

sections.title: This week’s trend
sections.body: Versus last week’s arc of cyber-specialized agents and productized agent memory, this week looked more like a shipping wave: Claude Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2, Gemini 4 Carbon’s general availability, and Hydrogen as a daily coding workhorse, plus ChatGPT Wallet bringing agentic payments into the product, Claude Meetings putting the model in the call, and OpenAI putting Daybreak red-teaming and a defense factory on stage. The full four points are in the weekly trend section below.

sections.title: Gaps
sections.body: @karpathy, @AndrewYNg, @OpenAI, @claudeai, @AIatMeta, and @Meta had no high-signal originals in the past 24–48 hours; today’s X section does not recycle yesterday’s posts. The watchlist still has no DeepSeek primary X account. OpenAI’s newsroom fetched as a challenge page today, so product coverage relies on the already checked Wallet post (Nov 13) and GitHub releases. Grok Bot 1.1.0 is only visible on the Homebrew cask; the official changelog does not list the changes.

title.zh: Cursor 对近期安全事件的调查更新
title.en: An update on Cursor’s recent security incident

summary.zh: 11/13 公司博文（本周早报尚未写过）：对 10 月底事件做了两周调查后的说明。攻击始于向 Fireworks 下发、后被暴露的访问密钥，攻击者据此复制了一个只读存储桶中的有限编码 agent 轨迹（多为 2025 年、非 Privacy Mode；不到 0.01% 的客户 API 凭证未打码）。随后进入部分内部 SaaS，并在 10/29 把恶意的 Claude Code 扩展副本放入 Cursor VS Code 扩展市场所用缓存（Open VSX 源站从未有该恶意包；最多约 5,000 名在约 11 小时窗口内请求特定缓存版本的用户可能拿到该构建）。官方称绝大多数客户未受影响，已直接通知受影响客户；称最后一次看到的攻击活动在 11/1 并已被阻断。Privacy Mode 下的提示与代码、以及当前线上流量不在此次暴露范围。这不是今日突发，而是补记一篇本周漏掉的官方说明。
summary.en: A Nov 13 company post (not yet covered in this week’s briefs) reports on a two-week investigation of the late-October incident. It started with an access key Cursor had issued to Fireworks that was later exposed; the attacker copied limited coding-agent traces from a read-only bucket (mostly from 2025, not in Privacy Mode; API credentials were unredacted for less than 0.01% of customers). From there they reached some internal SaaS tools, and on Oct 29 placed a malicious copy of Anthropic’s Claude Code extension on the cache that serves Cursor’s VS Code marketplace (Open VSX itself never had the malware; at most about 5,000 users who requested specific cached versions in an ~11-hour window may have received that build). Cursor says the vast majority of customers were not affected and that affected customers were notified directly, and that the last attacker activity it saw was on Nov 1 and was blocked. Prompts and code in Privacy Mode, and live traffic now, were not in the exposed set. This is a catch-up of a mid-week official note, not a same-day scoop.

alphaxivTop3.title: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding
alphaxivTop3.authors: Ellis Brown, Chris Hoang, Shengyi Qian, Shang-Wen Li, Mike Lewis, Marjan Ghazvininejad, Luke Zettlemoyer, Lucas Beyer, Mengye Ren, Jakob Verbeek, Saining Xie, Hu Xu et al.

summary.zh: （热榜第 1，较昨日仍居首位）把多模态模型里视觉编码器的三项设计拆开对照：上游预训练带来的视觉先验、专用视觉容量，以及融合前放置。在统一数据与算力下从头训练后发现：视觉先验并非必要，联合从头训练的编码器可与预训练编码器相当；真正关键的是专用视觉容量，无编码器方案即使把骨干做大仍落后，但这些容量不必放在融合之前。
summary.en: (Still #1 on alphaXiv’s trending list versus yesterday.) A controlled study that unbundles three choices in multimodal vision encoding: the visual prior from upstream pretraining, dedicated vision capacity, and whether that capacity sits before fusion. Trained from scratch on common data at matched compute, a jointly trained encoder matches a pretrained one — the visual prior is not necessary. Dedicated vision capacity is what matters; encoder-free models still trail even with a larger backbone, but that capacity need not precede fusion.

alphaxivTop3.title: Latent Feedback Is a Compute and Data Amplifier: Scaling Law for Latent Feedback Transformers on Repeated Data
alphaxivTop3.authors: Benhao Huang, Chaitanya Dwivedi, Xuezhe Ma, Alexander Moreno, Hector Liu

summary.zh: （热榜第 2，由昨日第 3 升至第 2）高质量数据耗尽后，常见做法是多轮重复训练，但每一轮的收益递减。本文研究潜空间反馈（把当前 token 顶层状态送入下一 token 输入）作为一种把算力花在重复数据上的方式，并给出在重复数据上的缩放律，称其可放大算力与数据效率。
summary.en: (#2 today, up from #3 yesterday.) When high-quality data runs out, a common practice is to train for several epochs, but each repeat is worth less than the last. The paper studies latent feedback — feeding each token’s top-layer state into the next token’s input — as another way to spend that compute on repeated data, and reports a scaling law in which latent feedback acts as a compute and data amplifier.

caption.en: Trending card for the latent-feedback scaling-law paper (source: alphaXiv; mirrored in-repo)

alphaxivTop3.title: Ropedia Xperience 2: A Gold Standard for Scaling Physical AI Environments and Behaviors
alphaxivTop3.authors: Hao Li, Fangzhou Hong, Zhaoxi Chen, Hui En Pang, Kairui Hu, Mingze Sun, Runmao Yao, Xinhao Ji, Xiyuan Zheng, Xuanli Chen, Yalun Dai, Yap Kim Hui et al.

summary.zh: （热榜第 3，由昨日第 2 降至第 3；具身/智能体相关）指出 GPT-6 Astra、Claude Fable 5.1 等基础模型已能从视觉直接控制机器人，但在长程、富接触的真实任务上仍脆。论文提出规模化的物理 AI 环境与行为「金标准」，强调需要可监督任务如何完成的人类行为示范，以及相应的环境资源。
summary.en: (#3 today, down from #2 yesterday; embodiment / agent-relevant.) Foundation models such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 can already control robots from visual observations, but remain brittle on long-horizon, contact-rich real-world tasks. The paper proposes a gold-standard resource for scaling physical-AI environments and behaviors, arguing that progress needs demonstrations of how humans perform tasks plus the matching environments.

summary.zh: 相对上周的「安全专用智能体 + Agent 记忆产品化 + 科学/日常评测」，本周主线换成一轮集中交付：Claude Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2、Gemini 4 Carbon 全面开放与 Hydrogen 日常编码主力相继落地；ChatGPT Wallet 把代理支付做进产品，Claude Meetings 让模型走进会议；OpenAI 则把 Daybreak 红队与防御工厂搬到台前。科学侧有 AlphaGenome 2、Gemini Decisions API，以及 WeatherNext 3 背后的 PARDIG / SatWeave 数据集。编码栈上，Codex 稳定版连发 0.168.0 与 0.169.0，CursorBench 上 Carbon 领跑、Hydrogen Extra High 进入官方第 6，OpenClaw 在周日打出以可靠性为主的 beta.3。缺口：关注列表仍无 DeepSeek 一手 X；Karpathy 与 Andrew Ng 本周后半段几乎静音；Cursor changelog 自 11/6 的 Voice Chat 后再无条目。
summary.en: Versus last week’s arc of cyber-specialized agents, productized agent memory, and science/everyday evals, this week was a shipping wave: Claude Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2, Gemini 4 Carbon’s general availability, and Hydrogen as a daily coding workhorse; ChatGPT Wallet brought agentic payments into the product, and Claude Meetings put the model in the call; OpenAI put Daybreak red-teaming and a defense factory on stage. On the science side the week added AlphaGenome 2, the Gemini Decisions API, and the PARDIG / SatWeave datasets behind WeatherNext 3. In the coding stack, Codex shipped stables 0.168.0 and 0.169.0, CursorBench still has Carbon in the lead with Hydrogen Extra High in the official top 6, and OpenClaw closed the week with a reliability-focused beta.3. Gaps: still no DeepSeek primary X on the watchlist; Karpathy and Andrew Ng were largely quiet in the second half of the week; Cursor’s changelog has had no entry since Voice Chat on Nov 6.

label.zh: 新一代主力模型在一周内扎堆落地
label.en: A cluster of flagship models landed in one week

text.zh: 11/10 @claudeai 与 @AnthropicAI 发布 Claude Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2；11/11 Gemini 4 Carbon 全面开放，定位长周期 agent 与网络安全工作流；11/13 再推出面向日常编码的 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，并在 Antigravity 上线 Orchestrator。11/14 CursorBench 4.0 新上榜 Hydrogen Extra High（57.8% / $5.86），进入官方得分第 6；官方榜仍由 Carbon High（60.4%）领跑。独立数学榜 MathArena 在 11/10 前后把 Carbon 置于 GPT-6.1 Sol 之前，成本也高一个数量级，宜作对照而非今日突发。
text.en: On Nov 10 @claudeai and @AnthropicAI launched Claude Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2; on Nov 11 Gemini 4 Carbon became generally available for long-horizon agent and cyber workflows; on Nov 13 Google followed with Gemini 4 Hydrogen for everyday coding and an Orchestrator in Antigravity. On Nov 14 CursorBench 4.0 added Hydrogen Extra High (57.8% / $5.86) at official #6, while Carbon High (60.4%) still leads the official board. The third-party MathArena board had also placed Carbon ahead of GPT-6.1 Sol around Nov 10, at an order-of-magnitude higher cost — useful context, not a same-day scoop.

label.zh: 智能体从写代码走进支付与会议
label.en: Agents moved from writing code into payments and meetings

text.zh: 11/13 OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Wallet，与 Amex / Mastercard / Visa 合作，在 dots 上向符合条件的美国 ChatGPT Pro 用户滚动代理支付，真实卡号不交给商家或智能体。11/12 Anthropic 推出 Claude Meetings（Team / Enterprise beta，先支持 Google Meet），可边开会边做纪要与文档。Grok Bot 官方 changelog 仍停在 11/11 的 v1.0.1（可加入 Meet / Zoom / Teams），但本周末 Homebrew cask 已从 1.0.3 升到 1.1.0，功能说明尚未出现在 changelog 里。
text.en: On Nov 13 OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet with Amex, Mastercard, and Visa, rolling agentic payments out in dots to eligible U.S. ChatGPT Pro users, without handing the raw card number to the merchant or the agent. On Nov 12 Anthropic launched Claude Meetings (Team / Enterprise beta, starting with Google Meet) so the model can take notes and draft docs during the call. Grok Bot’s official changelog is still v1.0.1 from Nov 11 (joining Meet, Zoom, or Teams), but the Homebrew cask moved from 1.0.3 to 1.1.0 over the weekend, with no official feature list yet.

label.zh: 安全能力继续被做成可对外的产品与评测
label.en: Security work kept being packaged as products and evals

text.zh: 11/12 OpenAI 的 Cyber at the Frontier 直播把 Daybreak Red Team 与 Defense Factory 推到台前，Tibo 随后公开征求 Codex 改进意见并强调「尽量别只提模型」。11/13 Anthropic 工程博客给出安全评测的 10 条建议。同日 Cursor 发布对 10 月底安全事件的调查更新：攻击始于向 Fireworks 下发、后被暴露的访问密钥，并一度把恶意的 Claude Code 扩展副本放进 Cursor 的 VS Code 扩展市场缓存；官方称绝大多数客户未受影响，并已直接通知受影响客户。DeepMind 本周还有 AlphaProof Code 形式化验证 Signal 协议实现的进展。
text.en: On Nov 12 OpenAI’s Cyber at the Frontier livestream put Daybreak Red Team and Defense Factory on stage, and Tibo later asked how Codex could improve — “try not to say model.” On Nov 13 Anthropic’s Engineering Blog offered 10 recommendations for safety evaluations. The same day Cursor published a follow-up on the late-October security incident: it started with an access key issued to Fireworks that was later exposed, and a malicious copy of the Claude Code extension was placed on Cursor’s VS Code marketplace cache; Cursor says the vast majority of customers were not affected and that affected customers were notified directly. DeepMind also progressed AlphaProof Code’s formal verification of Signal’s protocol implementation.

label.zh: 科学工具与编码栈并行推进，产品日志则快慢不一
label.en: Science tools and coding stacks moved in parallel, while product logs moved unevenly

text.zh: 科学与决策侧，11/12 DeepMind 发布 AlphaGenome 2，Google 推出 Gemini Decisions API；11/13 又开源 WeatherNext 3 背后的 PARDIG（全球降水）与 SatWeave（多星云与风暴图）。编码产品上，Codex 在 11/13 连发稳定版 0.168.0 与 0.169.0，GitHub Copilot 上线 Hydrogen；OpenClaw 在 11/15 早以 v2026.11.5-beta.3 做了一轮大会话与重启可靠性修补。另一面是节奏差：Cursor changelog 自 11/6 Voice Chat 后再无条目（11/10 的 Projects 多人博文未进 changelog）；关注列表仍无 DeepSeek 一手 X，Karpathy 与 Andrew Ng 本周后半段几乎没有高信号原创。
text.en: On the science and decision side, DeepMind released AlphaGenome 2 on Nov 12, Google launched the Gemini Decisions API, and on Nov 13 it opened the PARDIG (global precipitation) and SatWeave (multi-satellite cloud and storm) datasets behind WeatherNext 3. In coding products, Codex shipped stables 0.168.0 and 0.169.0 on Nov 13, GitHub Copilot added Hydrogen, and OpenClaw followed on the morning of Nov 15 with v2026.11.5-beta.3, a large-session and restart reliability patch. The pace was uneven elsewhere: Cursor’s changelog has had no entry since Voice Chat on Nov 6 (the Nov 10 “Projects is now multiplayer” blog did not land in the changelog); the watchlist still has no DeepSeek primary X account, and Karpathy and Andrew Ng had almost no high-signal originals in the second half of the week.

summary.zh: 稳定版仍为 v0.23.1（2026-11-10T01:42:15Z）。昨日早报之后新出现 canary v0.23.1+canary.20261114T064334Z（published_at 2026-11-14T07:46:34Z，约北京时间 15:46），发布说明仅有各平台安装包与 smoke 结果，没有整理过的功能列表，故不编造。再上一档 canary 为 20261113T064447Z。
summary.en: Stable remains v0.23.1 (2026-11-10T01:42:15Z). After yesterday’s brief a new canary appeared, v0.23.1+canary.20261114T064334Z (published_at 2026-11-14T07:46:34Z, about 15:46 Asia/Shanghai). Its notes only list packages and smoke results, with no curated feature list, so none is invented here. The previous canary was 20261113T064447Z.

summary.zh: 新预发布 v2026.11.5-beta.3（GitHub published_at 2026-11-15T00:31:00Z，约北京时间 08:31）。要点是降低大会话在转写索引、裁剪与压缩时的内存压力，重启时保留排队消息的权限上限与已接受的入口，并改进冷启动、中断工作区恢复与安装权限。此外恢复按上下文大小的默认输出预算、可配置摘要字数上限（引用摘要中会打码凭证），以及 Lightpanda 浏览路径与沙箱文件就绪等待。官方说明按 beta.2 之后的窗口统计为 50 个 PR。此前最新预发布为 v2026.11.5-beta.2。
summary.en: New prerelease v2026.11.5-beta.3 (GitHub published_at 2026-11-15T00:31:00Z, about 08:31 Asia/Shanghai). It lowers memory pressure during transcript indexing, trimming, and compaction, preserves queued-message permission ceilings and accepted ingress across restarts, and improves cold-start initialization, interrupted-workspace recovery, and installer permissions. It also restores context-sized default output budgets, adds a configurable summary-character limit (with credentials redacted in quoted summaries), and waits for Lightpanda’s supported navigation path and sandbox files to be ready. The official notes tally 50 PRs in the window after beta.2. The previous latest prerelease was v2026.11.5-beta.2.

summary.zh: 仍为昨日所见的实验标签 dsh-v0.2.2-rc.3（2026-11-13T07:56:55Z），无更新标签。该版本新增实验性「DeepSeek 会话导入」插件，并修复 Windows 桌面版应用内更新可能失败、无法自动重新打开的问题。
summary.en: Still the experimental tag seen yesterday, dsh-v0.2.2-rc.3 (2026-11-13T07:56:55Z), with no newer tag. That release adds an experimental DeepSeek chat-import plugin and fixes Windows desktop in-app updates that could fail and not reopen automatically.

The experimental line moved from yesterday’s 0.171.0-alpha.4 to rust-v0.171.0-alpha.5 (2026-11-14T01:20:37Z, about 09:20 Asia/Shanghai). summary.zh: 自昨日早报之后，Anthropic 新闻页与可核对的产品稿无新条目。仍以 11/12 的 Claude Meetings（Team / Enterprise beta，先支持 Google Meet）以及同日进入私人预览的自托管 Claude Managed Agents 为最近产品动态。11/13 的安全评测工程博客已在昨日技术动态写过；今日无新的 Claude 官方 X 原创。
summary.en: No new product post on Anthropic’s newsroom or a verifiable changelog since yesterday’s brief. The latest product news remains Claude Meetings from Nov 12 (beta on Team and Enterprise, starting with Google Meet) and self-hosted Claude Managed Agents entering private beta the same day. The Nov 13 safety-evaluations engineering blog was already covered in yesterday’s tech section; there was no new official Claude original on X today.

summary.zh: 自 11/6 起 changelog 仍无更新条目。页面置顶仍为 2026-11-06 Voice Chat with Agents——与 agent 实时语音通话，由 Grok Voice 驱动，可在 Agents 窗口、IDE、Web 与 iOS 使用。11/13 的公司博文《An update on our recent security incident》已写入技术动态的工程博客栏；11/10 的「Cursor Projects is now multiplayer」产品博文本周 changelog 仍未收录，已放入本周趋势。
summary.en: Still no new changelog entry since Nov 6. The page still leads with Voice Chat with Agents (2026-11-06): a realtime voice call with the agent, powered by Grok Voice, in the Agents Window, the IDE, on the web, and on iOS. The Nov 13 company post “An update on our recent security incident” is in the engineering-blog section; the Nov 10 “Cursor Projects is now multiplayer” product post still has not landed in the changelog, and is noted in the weekly trend.

summary.zh: 官方 changelog Latest 仍为 v1.0.1（2026-11-11，条目亦包含 1.0.0）：Team / Enterprise / Ultra 计划下，Bot 可从链接加入 Google Meet、Zoom 或 Microsoft Teams，在会议聊天中回复并会后发送摘要，并支持共享登录连接器等。Homebrew cask grok-bot 今日已报 1.1.0（下载地址指向 darwin-arm64 的 1.1.0 安装包），高于昨日所见的 1.0.3，也高于 changelog Latest。按对照规则，不以「近几日无新版本」表述；1.1.0 的功能说明官方 changelog 尚未列出，故不编造。
summary.en: The official changelog Latest is still v1.0.1 (2026-11-11, and the entry also includes 1.0.0): on Team, Enterprise, and Ultra plans, a Bot can join Google Meet, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams from a link, reply in meeting chat, and send a summary afterward, and it supports shared-login connectors. The Homebrew cask grok-bot now reports 1.1.0 (the download points at the darwin-arm64 1.1.0 package), ahead of yesterday’s 1.0.3 and ahead of changelog Latest. Under the client-vs-changelog rule, this is not written as “no recent new version.” The official changelog does not yet list what 1.1.0 changes, so those features are not invented here.

summary.en: Ranked by score ÷ cost per task, the highest-value configs remain the cheapest ones: GPT-5.6 Luna Low (16.0% / $0.03, about 533 pts/$) and Haiku 5.5 Low (30.9% / $0.08).
